# case:   override

=== task: filter ===

    if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($item)) {
    }
  $inputText = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd()
  $matching = $env:SKIPFILES_MATCHING -eq "true"

  cat >/dev/null
  foreach ($item in ($inputText -split "`r?`n")) {
  if ($matching) { exit 0 }
  }
 not for current platform - ignored

fi
task: "_filter:empty" finished

=== task: go-packages ===




    " ", [System.StringSplitOptions]::RemoveEmptyEntries
    throw "The go executable is required by go-packages."
  $ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
  $targets = @(([string]$env:SKIPFILES_GO_TARGETS).Split(
  & go list @targets
  ))
  exit 1
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
  if ($targets.Count -eq 0) { $targets = @("./...") }
  if (-not (Get-Command go -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
  printf '%s
  printf '%s\0' "$import_path"
  }
 not for current platform - ignored
# Intentional word splitting preserves the public interface.
# shellcheck disable=SC2086
'
' 'The go executable is required by go-packages.' >&2
command -v go >/dev/null 2>&1 || {
done
go list $targets | while IFS= read -r import_path; do
targets="${SKIPFILES_GO_TARGETS:-./...}"
task: "_go-packages:all" finished
task: "_go-packages:all" started
task: "go-packages" finished
task: "go-packages" started
task: [_go-packages:all] powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command '
task: [_go-packages:all] set -euo pipefail
task: [go-packages] if condition not met - skipped
task: [go-packages] if condition not met - skipped
